verdicts.decision_note: The client requires CJ-sourced products to be recorded in the product list, while the immediately preceding context resolves that list as the spreadsheet; this establishes an implementation-relevant data artifact.
The client changes the spreadsheet data organization by requiring reuse of the existing artifact and separate TikTok Shop and website record areas.
This is the first target-specific implementation claim that the spreadsheet was populated with the required information, including the concrete temporary sheet location.
